list.title: Playlists
list.noneBody: Make one here, or use “Add to playlist” on a movie, show, album or episode (also when holding OK on a poster).

page.notFoundBody: It was deleted, or it belongs to another profile.
page.emptySmart: Nothing matches this playlist's filter yet.
page.emptyVideo: This playlist is empty. Use “Add to playlist” on a movie, show or episode, or hold OK on a poster.
page.emptyMusic: This playlist is empty. Use “Add to playlist” on an artist or album, or hold OK on a cover.
page.moving: Up and down to move it, OK to drop it here, Back to put it back
page.deleteBody: “{{title}}” will be deleted. What's in it stays in your libraries.

form.title: Title
form.hint: Press OK on the title to type it.
form.newBody: Name it, then add to it with “Add to playlist” on any title.
form.smartBody: It keeps up with the library by itself.
form.smartBodyFilters: {{filters}}. It keeps up with the library by itself.

add.title: Add to playlist
add.noneVideo: No video playlists yet: name one above.
add.noneMusic: No music playlists yet: name one above.
